The evidence provided is the abstract of an empirical, qualitative interview study ("We conducted a series of expert interviews and analyzed the data using thematic analysis. Awareness of AI issues, measuring AI impacts, and governing AI processes emerged as the three main themes..."). 

In contrast, the candidate hypothesis describes an intricate quantitative framework involving natural language processing, spaCy models, knowledge graphs, graph neural networks, the specific "AI4People" framework, mathematical formulas for risk scoring, Delphi-method expert elicitation, and XGBoost regression modeling. 

This elaborate algorithmic proposal is not the hypothesis or subject investigated or supported by the provided study abstract.

VERDICT: REJECT
